reasons.correctness: updateTicketStatus publishes SupportTicketResolvedEvent only for RESOLVED, matching the interface. All tests pass. addAdminResponse can also set RESOLVED through newStatus but publishes no event, so that path leaves the customer uninformed.
reasons.convention_fit: Port and adapter sit in support/ticket/port and adapter. The listener uses @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT) with catch-and-log. Injection is constructor-only (@RequiredArgsConstructor, extended explicit constructor). Tests use MockitoExtension, and the existing service test was updated.
reasons.design_fit: Clean port/adapter split; the listener depends only on TicketNotificationPort. EmailTicketNotificationAdapter hardcodes English HTML and ignores the language-aware pattern of the other EmailService methods. The resolve trigger in addAdminResponse is left out.
reasons.test_quality: Adapter test captures recipient, subject and text. Listener tests cover the happy path and a port failure with assertDoesNotThrow. Service tests verify the event payload for RESOLVED and verifyNoInteractions for IN_PROGRESS/CLOSED. No Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the support package files and existing Event/Listener/Port examples, and TESTED_BY found SupportTicketServiceUnitTest before any edit. The agent read the InvoiceCreated listener and FakturowniaAdapter exemplars and followed their structure.
